integrity: Exact symbolic proof via character orthogonality, Newton identities, and symmetric-means inequalities; exact-rational tests plus direct Fourier tests are supplemental only. The global best constant is attained by one-point-supported functions. This is same-model review, not an independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Only the cubic moment curve in finite fields of characteristic greater than three; no phase stability, higher-degree global constant, or Euclidean claim. Primary full-text originality comparison to the two 2026 preprints was inaccessible; equivalent unindexed sharp coefficients remain a risk.
title: Sharp global quadratic stability of cubic moment-curve Fourier extension
